name: com.holadivinus.blpreviewtool
description:
MarrowSDK Addon (Patch 6) that remotely loads Spawnable, Level, and Avatar data from your bonelab install / Mods, and can realise it into saveable project assets.
Browse, preview and dump content via Stress Level Zero > Void Tools > (BLPTool) Content Browser, or call BLPTool.BLPApi from editor code.
Access the Level Loader via Stress Level Zero > Void Tools > (BLPTool) Level Loader.
Refference SLZ Materials via Stress Level Zero > Void Tools > (BLPTool) External Material Copier.
